name: combat-round-waits-hits
description: The next combat round waits for the previous round's hits (pbd203: a ground round was rolled while the opponent's hit was unassigned). pbd60@151: mentak owes 1 ground hit on andeara; its 'Roll Dice For Combat Round' is refused by the engine (the original code rolls; legacy fork: no press), then mentak auto-assigns on both forks.
